power_safety_finding.power_source: USB strongly indicated by disconnected battery and schematic path
power_safety_finding.cause: USB VUSB is ideal-diode ORed to VRAW; with the board switch on, VRAW feeds VIN and the DRV8411A motor-driver VM pins. XRPLib returns true whenever measured VIN exceeds 4.272 V and does not distinguish USB from battery power.
power_safety_finding.physical_indicator: The board MOT LED indicates availability of the VIN-derived motor/servo supply; its visual state was not recorded by the automated probe.
power_safety_finding.safety_consequence: No nonzero effort is permitted until a separate H2 run with wheels raised, explicit human confirmation, hard effort and duration limits, and zero-before/after cleanup.

checks.detail: Verified UF2 copied only to the RP2350 bootloader volume; controller re-enumerated as MicroPython.
MicroPython version, machine, build, _mpy, memory, and filesystem observed over USB.
XRPLib, ble, phew, and XRPExamples installed; representative XRPLib file hashes match the pinned upstream source.
All seven canonical course package files were installed under /lib/ucsb_xrp and every remote SHA-256 matches the host release source.

The package imported on RP2350 MicroPython, retained max_effort 0 motion lock, read records and sensors, normalized +pi consistently after a measured float32 correction, and commanded zero effort in finally cleanup.
Runtime probe succeeded in the same mpremote operation after a soft reset.
Status LED on and off commands completed without exception.
Button input was readable and observed released; physical press transition was not exercised.
IMU reported connected and returned acceleration, angular rate, and temperature.
Rangefinder returned 26.9072168 cm in the final recorded run.
Both encoders were readable; effort 0.0 was commanded before and after other checks and again in finally cleanup.
Measured VIN and the XRP power circuit indicate that USB was energizing the motor-driver supply. SW1-off and MOT-LED-off confirmations were not available; the run remained zero-effort only.
No manual wheel rotation was performed during the automated run.
No nonzero motor effort was issued.
RM2 behavior and the Wi-Fi/browser path were not exercised while the Mac remained on development Wi-Fi.
